decisions.reason: The message specifies how clips are submitted for audit but does not change the client's approval authority, approval criteria, quota-counting rules, or publication eligibility.
The initial three-clip trial had already been reviewed and passed; the new submission-channel instruction concerns the current clip batch and does not alter the historical trial requirement.
Submitting a Google Drive link through project chat for audit does not change the clips' target publication channels.
The submission-channel instruction does not change the required completeness, educational value, or standalone comprehension of each clip.
The message changes where the completed clips' link is submitted, not which source videos or moments may be selected.
The delivery instruction does not modify the requirement to use suitable low-volume background music beneath Teyron's voice.
The submission-channel decision does not change how B-roll must support the spoken message.
The message does not change the clean editing style or prohibition on distracting effects.
The batch remains five production clips intended for publication; its Google Drive packaging and project-chat link submission are independently represented by the source Requirement.
The submission-channel instruction does not modify the required 45-to-60-second clip duration.
The message does not change caption color, font, or effects requirements.
The requalification batch was a prior task with its own completed review trajectory; the current Google Drive and project-chat submission instruction does not alter it.
